sections.heading: Make cupboard access workable

faqs.question: How should I prepare a cylinder cupboard before a Hammersmith service visit?
faqs.answer: Clear stored items where safe and describe restricted access; leave the cylinder, wiring, controls and pipework in place for the engineer.
